promptZh: 伦勃朗光(Rembrandt Lighting):主光位于面部一侧约四十五度方位、四十五度高度,鼻侧阴影向下延伸并与颧骨阴影相接,在背光那侧的颧骨上留出一小块倒三角形亮区,亮区宽度不超过眼睛、长度不过鼻底;光比控制在四比一到八比一,暗部保留可辨的层次;立体感强而克制,是最经典的戏剧人像光
promptEn: key light at roughly forty-five degrees to the side and forty-five degrees above, the shadow from the nose reaching down to meet the cheek shadow and leaving a small inverted triangle of light on the shadow-side cheek, no wider than the eye and no longer than the base of the nose, contrast four to eight to one with detail held in the shadows, sculpted and restrained, the classic dramatic portrait key

promptZh: 低调硬光:画面绝大部分落在暗部,只有很小面积被硬光照亮;光源面积小、距离远,阴影边缘锐利没有过渡;光比十比一以上,暗部压到接近纯黑但仍留一丝层次;不做任何补光,信息被光严格配给,观众只能看到被允许看到的部分,电影级写实质感,高清细节
promptEn: the overwhelming majority of the frame sitting in shadow with only a small area caught by a hard source, that source small and distant so the shadow edges are razor sharp with no transition, contrast beyond ten to one and the blacks crushed to just short of pure, no fill at all, information strictly rationed by light

promptZh: 体积光束：以方向明确的明暗层次表现光束感；仅利用正文已有的空气介质，不添加烟雾或改变主体站位
promptEn: Use directional contrast to suggest light shafts, using only atmospheric media already in the script; do not add haze or reposition the subject

promptZh: 侧逆光：侧后上方轮廓光勾亮发丝与肩线，亮侧层次完整，暗侧自然过渡；仅在已有介质中呈现光晕
promptEn: Use a raised side backlight to trace hair and shoulders, with detailed highlights and a natural shadow transition; show halos only in existing atmospheric media

promptZh: 分割光(Split Lighting):主光置于正侧九十度方位、与眼睛等高;面部被沿鼻梁中轴垂直切成受光与不受光的两半,分界线锐利;受光半保留完整层次,暗半几乎只剩轮廓,光比八比一以上;不做补光时人格的两面性被直接写在脸上
promptEn: key light at a full ninety degrees to the side at eye height, splitting the face vertically along the axis of the nose into a lit half and an unlit half with a hard boundary, the lit side holding full detail while the dark side keeps almost nothing but contour, contrast beyond eight to one, no fill

promptZh: 单光源明暗法:全场只用一支光,其余全部依靠环境的自然反射;明暗过渡承担了全部造型工作,从亮部到暗部有连续而缓慢的层次推移;光源略高于眼位、偏侧,暗部不做任何人工填充但因反射而不死;质感厚重、真实、有古典绘画的体积感,电影级写实
promptEn: a single source for the entire scene with everything else relying on natural bounce, the gradation from light to dark doing all the modelling in a continuous slow roll-off, the source slightly above the eyeline and off to one side, the shadows given no artificial fill yet never dead thanks to reflection, weighty and painterly

promptZh: 双色对冲边光:主体两侧各一支色温相反的边光,一侧冷蓝、一侧暖橙,同时描出两条颜色不同的轮廓线;正面几乎不给光,面部留在暗中,只有两侧的颜色在争夺轮廓;两色的强度大致相等,谁也压不过谁;分裂、对立、风格化,电影级写实氛围
promptEn: two rim lights of opposing colour temperature on either side of the subject, one cool blue and one warm orange, tracing two differently coloured contour lines at once, almost nothing from the front so the face stays dark and only the two colours compete for the outline, their intensities matched so neither wins

promptZh: 大柔光包裹:极大面积的柔光源贴近主体,光几乎从各个角度包裹上来;阴影边缘完全溶解,过渡长到看不出起点与终点,皮肤质感被抹平但保留通透;光比二比一左右,眼睛里有大而柔和的眼神光;干净、昂贵、无攻击性的商业质感,电影级写实,高清细节
promptEn: an extremely large soft source placed close to the subject so the light wraps in from nearly every angle, shadow edges dissolved completely and the transition so long its start and end cannot be located, skin smoothed yet still translucent, contrast around two to one with a large soft catchlight in the eyes, clean and expensive

promptZh: 天光顶洒：中性偏冷的顶向光照亮发顶与肩部，保留短阴影与暗部细节，不添加微尘
promptEn: Use neutral-cool overhead light with clear crown and shoulder highlights, short shadows and retained shadow detail; add no dust

promptZh: 宽边光(Broad Lighting):人物面部略转向一侧,主光打在朝向镜头的那半张脸上,受光面积大于暗部;面颊被照亮后显得开阔,骨相被弱化,五官更平缓;光比二比一到三比一,整体明快;适合需要亲和、开放、无攻击性的人物
promptEn: the face turned slightly away with the key falling on the half facing the lens so the lit area exceeds the shadow, the cheek reading wide and open while the bone structure softens and the features flatten, contrast two to three to one, bright and approachable

promptZh: 屏幕冷光:一块面积不大的冷蓝色面光源置于主体正前偏下,亮度很低,只把面部中心、下巴与手部照亮,眼窝与两侧迅速沉入暗;色温在六千五百开尔文以上,画面整体压在低调;光强随内容轻微起伏,阴影跟着呼吸般变化;疏离、专注而略带不安,写实质感,高清细节
promptEn: a small cool blue panel placed low and directly in front of the subject at very low intensity, lighting only the center of the face, the chin and the hands while the eye sockets and the sides fall away fast, colour temperature above sixty-five hundred kelvin with the image held low key, the level fluctuating slightly so the shadows breathe, detached and uneasy, photoreal, high detail

promptZh: 屏风漏影：采用细密交错的碎影光效，中低调、暗部丰富、中性偏暖；不新增屏风或隔断
promptEn: Use fine interleaved patterned shadows, lower midtones, rich shadow detail and neutral-warm color; add no screen or partition

promptZh: 扫掠光带：定向光带横向扫掠，轮廓短暂提亮后自然回落；节奏服从原动作和片段时长，保持关键信息可见
promptEn: Use a directional lateral sweep with briefly lifted contours; fit its rhythm to the existing action and duration while keeping essential information visible

promptZh: 晨雾柔光：柔和均匀漫射、低对比、浅阴影、冷白高光，呈现晨雾般通透质感；不添加雾、不更改时段
promptEn: Use even diffusion, low contrast, shallow shadows and cool-white highlights for a mist-like softness; add no fog and retain the time of day

promptZh: 月下冷光:唯一光源来自侧上方高处,强度低、质地柔和,色温在七千开尔文以上呈明显冷蓝;面部只有很淡的高光与柔和的阴影过渡,整体压在中低调;暗部大面积但不死黑,保留可辨的层次;空气清冷通透,宁静而疏离,写实质感,高清细节,电影级氛围
promptEn: a single source high and to one side, low in intensity and soft in quality, colour temperature above seven thousand kelvin with a distinctly cool blue cast, only faint highlights and gentle shadow transitions across the face with the whole image held in the lower mid tones, the shadows broad but never crushed and still legible, the air cold and clear, quiet and remote, photoreal, high detail

promptZh: 水波反光：用柔亮游移的网状光斑表现水波反射感，冷暖轻微交织；不新增水面或水体
promptEn: Suggest water caustics through softly shifting light patterns with subtle warm-cool variation; add no water surface or body of water

promptZh: 沙尘暖雾：暖橙色调、抬升黑位、柔化远景对比，呈现沙尘般粗粝光感；不添加沙尘或改变能见度事实
promptEn: Use warm orange grading, lifted blacks and softly reduced distance contrast for a dusty texture; add no dust and retain established visibility

promptZh: 混色光污染：青绿与品红光色交叠，高饱和、非均匀明暗形成混色光感；不更改场景、时段或光源道具
promptEn: Overlap cyan-green and magenta tones with saturated, uneven illumination; retain the setting, time and existing light-source props

promptZh: 炉火映面：低位暖色底光映亮下颌与眼底，亮度柔和起伏；仅表现炉火般色调，不新增火焰
promptEn: Use low warm uplight with gently varying intensity on the jaw and lower eyelids; suggest firelight color without adding flames

promptZh: 烛光：低亮暖橙红小面积光，快速衰减、柔和光晕与轻微亮度起伏；不新增蜡烛或火焰
promptEn: Use a dim warm orange-red light with fast falloff, soft glow and gentle intensity variation; add no candle or flame

promptZh: 环形光(Loop Lighting):主光偏离正面三十到四十五度、略高于眼位;鼻影呈短小的环状落在脸颊上,但不与颧骨阴影相连,始终保持一小段亮的缝隙;光比三比一左右,面部大部分保持通透;最自然也最保险的人像光,适合绝大多数脸型
promptEn: key light thirty to forty-five degrees off axis and slightly above the eyeline, the nose casting a small loop of shadow onto the cheek that never connects with the cheek shadow, a thin band of light always kept between them, contrast around three to one with most of the face staying open, the most natural and forgiving portrait key

promptZh: 琉璃折光：清晰的多色色斑沿主体结构产生细微色散，背景相对压暗；不新增彩色玻璃或其他道具
promptEn: Use bounded multicolor light patches and subtle dispersion over the existing subject, with a relatively darker background; add no glass or other props

promptZh: 短边光(Short Lighting):人物面部略转向一侧,主光打在背对镜头的那半张脸上,靠近镜头的一侧落入阴影;受光面积小于暗部面积,面颊被暗部收窄,轮廓与骨相被强化;光比五比一左右,是显瘦与增强立体感的标准做法
promptEn: the face turned slightly away with the key falling on the half pointing away from the lens while the near side drops into shadow, the lit area smaller than the shadow area so the cheek is narrowed and the bone structure emphasised, contrast around five to one, the standard choice for slimming and depth

promptZh: 窗棂光：侧前方柔暖白光形成规则条状明暗，阴影边缘微柔、暗部层次丰富；不新增窗户
promptEn: Use soft warm-white front-side light with regular bands, slightly softened shadow edges and rich shadow detail; add no window

promptZh: 竹影斑驳：中性偏冷的细长斑驳光影，亮部清爽、暗部通透；仅表现竹影质感，不新增竹林、风或枝叶
promptEn: Use slender dappled neutral-cool shadows with clean highlights and open dark tones; suggest bamboo-shadow texture without adding plants or wind

promptZh: 纱帐漫射:主光源被一层半透明介质过滤,变成面积很大的柔性漫射光,几乎不产生硬边阴影;主体的五官被均匀包裹,过渡极其平滑,轮廓边缘出现轻微辉光;整体压在高调,肤质细腻通透,色温偏暖;安静、朦胧、温婉,写实质感,高清细节,电影级真实感
promptEn: the key filtered through a semi-transparent layer into a very large soft source that casts almost no hard-edged shadow, the features evenly wrapped with extremely smooth transitions and a faint glow blooming at the contour, the whole image held high key with fine translucent skin and a warm temperature, quiet, hazy and gentle, photoreal, high detail

promptZh: 舞台追光：以高位定向光突出主体，周边降低亮度但保留叙事信息；光区随原动作适配，不限制主体移动
promptEn: Emphasize the subject with raised directional light and darker surroundings while retaining narrative information; adapt illumination to the existing movement

promptZh: 花窗彩影：采用冷暖交替、边缘清晰的几何彩影，亮部细致、暗部有层次；不新增花窗或改变建筑
promptEn: Use crisp geometric colored shadows with alternating warm-cool tones and retained tonal detail; add no window or architectural change

promptZh: 蓝调时刻：柔和深蓝色调、浅阴影与暖色高光对比，表现蓝调时刻的视觉感受；保持原有时段
promptEn: Use soft deep-blue grading, shallow shadows and contrasting warm highlights for a blue-hour appearance while retaining the scripted time of day

promptZh: 蝴蝶光(Butterfly / Paramount):主光置于镜头正上方约四十五度高度,与面部中轴严格对齐;鼻下形成左右对称的短小蝴蝶形阴影,颧骨被均匀提亮,下颌处阴影收紧使脸型显瘦;光比二比一到四比一,过渡柔和;整体明亮、对称、上镜,气质华丽而稳定
promptEn: key light placed directly above the lens at about forty-five degrees, aligned precisely with the facial axis, casting a small symmetrical butterfly shadow under the nose while the cheekbones lift evenly and the shadow under the jaw tightens the face, contrast two to four to one with soft transitions, bright, symmetrical and glamorous

promptZh: 边缘轮廓光:主要照明来自主体后方两侧,只在肩线、发际与侧脸边缘描出一道明亮的细线;正面给极弱的补光,让五官刚好可辨而不明亮;背景保持深暗,主体因这条边线从黑暗中被剥离出来;神秘而不至于完全失去表情,电影级写实质感
promptEn: the main illumination coming from behind and to both sides, tracing a bright thin line along the shoulders, the hairline and the edge of the face, with only the faintest fill from the front so the features are just barely readable, the background held deep dark and the subject peeled out of it by that rim alone

promptZh: 金属冷辉:一束窄而硬的冷色光从侧面掠过,只在下颌、眼尾与额角等结构边缘留下锐利的高光切面,其余部分迅速沉入深暗;光比拉到十比一以上,几乎没有过渡;色温偏冷,高光带金属般的镜面质感;气质凌厉肃杀,写实质感,高清细节,电影级氛围
promptEn: a narrow hard cool beam grazing across from the side, leaving razor sharp facets of highlight only along the jaw, the outer corner of the eye and the temple while everything else drops fast into deep shadow, contrast beyond ten to one with almost no transition, a cool temperature and a metallic specular quality to the highlights, severe and unforgiving, photoreal, high detail

promptZh: 阴云漫射：宽广柔和漫射光、浅阴影、低对比与偏冷色调；表现阴云光感，不新增云层或更改天气
promptEn: Use broad diffusion, shallow shadows, low contrast and a cool cast to suggest overcast light without changing weather

promptZh: 雨夜霓虹：高饱和彩色轮廓光、冷暖对比与柔和背景散景，表现雨夜霓虹色感；不添加雨、水汽或湿润表面
promptEn: Use saturated colored rims, warm-cool contrast and soft background bokeh for a rainy-neon palette; add no rain, mist or wet surfaces

promptZh: 雨帘透光：柔化的透射逆光、轻微低对比与细丝状高光；仅利用正文已有水线，不新增降雨、水幕或改变站位
promptEn: Use softened transmitted backlight, slightly reduced contrast and fine highlights only on existing water threads; add no rain or water curtain and retain positions

promptZh: 雪地返照：柔和返照填充阴影、冷白高调、低对比但保留结构；表现雪地返光质感，不新增雪或更换地面
promptEn: Use soft bounce fill, cool-white high-key tones and low contrast with retained structure; suggest snow bounce without adding snow or replacing the ground

promptZh: 雷暴闪光：短促明亮光效与暗部形成对比，强度和节奏服从原剧情与时长；不新增雷雨或雷声，避免抹去动作信息
promptEn: Use brief light accents against darker tones, fitting intensity and rhythm to the script and duration; add no storm or thunder and preserve readable action

promptZh: 霞光掠影:低角度的暖色光从斜前方掠过面部,只擦亮颧骨、鼻梁与眼底,形成柔和而短暂的金红色高光;光线角度极低,阴影被拉得很长;背景相对压暗,色温在三千开尔文左右并向暖端偏移;气质温柔而带离别感,电影级写实氛围,高清细节
promptEn: a low warm source grazing across the face from the front side, brushing light onto only the cheekbone, the bridge of the nose and the lower eyelids as a soft transient gold red highlight, the angle so low that shadows stretch long, the background relatively darkened and the temperature around three thousand kelvin pushed warm, tender and touched with parting, cinematic realism, high detail

promptZh: 顶光直射:强而硬的光源置于正上方九十度,直射而下;眼窝、鼻下与下颌形成深而短促的黑影,眼睛几乎不受光,颧骨与鼻梁被强行提亮;光比很大且过渡极短,面部结构被切割得支离;不适合讨好人物,专用于制造非人感与压迫,电影级写实
promptEn: a hard source directly overhead at ninety degrees firing straight down, the eye sockets, the area under the nose and the jaw dropping into deep short shadows with the eyes barely lit while the cheekbones and nose bridge are forced bright, high contrast with almost no transition, the face fragmented, deliberately unflattering

promptZh: 频闪硬光：采用克制的硬光明暗脉动表现频闪感，完整保留动作、台词和时间连续性，不黑屏或新增定格
promptEn: Suggest a hard-strobe look through restrained light pulses while preserving readable action, dialogue and temporal continuity; add no blackouts or frozen frames

promptZh: 高调平光:主光与补光几乎等强,来自正面略偏两侧,阴影被填到几乎不可见;整体亮度上抬,中间调集中在高区,背景同样提亮甚至接近纯白;光比小于二比一,面部通透干净但立体感被刻意抹去;明亮、无威胁、略带失真的洁净感,电影级写实
promptEn: key and fill of nearly equal strength coming from the front and slightly off both sides, the shadows filled until almost invisible, overall brightness lifted with the midtones clustered high and the background pushed bright or near white, contrast under two to one, the face clean and translucent with modelling deliberately erased

promptZh: 黄金时刻：低角度金橙色光、柔长阴影与暖色轮廓，呈现黄金时刻质感；不更改场次时段、天气或场景
promptEn: Use low golden-orange light, soft elongated shadows and warm rim tones for a golden-hour look while retaining time, weather and setting

promptZh: 一点透视推轨：沿现有空间的视觉中轴平稳推进，利用已有线条形成一点透视；不新增对称结构或通道
promptEn: Dolly smoothly along the existing visual axis, using available lines for one-point perspective; add no corridor or symmetrical structure

promptZh: 一镜到底：在本作用范围内采用连续跟随与平滑重新取景，仅呈现原有动作和空间，不新增走位、对象或跨场转换
promptEn: Use continuous following and smooth reframing within this scope, showing only existing action and space without new blocking, subjects or scene transitions

promptZh: 上帝视角俯冲：从俯视角度平滑下降并轻微旋转，逐步趋近平视；幅度与速度适配已有空间及片段时长
promptEn: Descend smoothly from a top-down view with gentle rotation toward eye level; fit the travel and speed to the available space and segment duration

promptZh: 中景(Medium Shot):标准焦段取景腰部以上,手部动作与面部表情同时留在画框内;主体与所处空间的关系被完整交代,身后的层次参与叙事却不喧宾夺主;两侧留出足够的动作余量,主体可以在不出画的前提下转身、抬手、后退;这是最中性也最可靠的叙事景别
promptEn: a standard lens framing from the waist up so gestures and facial expression both stay in shot, the subject's relationship to the space fully stated with the layers behind them contributing without competing, enough margin at the sides to turn, raise an arm or step back without leaving frame, the most neutral and dependable size in the language

promptZh: 中近景(Medium Close-up):中焦段取景自胸口以上,机位与主体眼睛等高;表情与上半身姿态同时可读,肩膀的紧绷或松弛成为表情之外的第二层信息;背景轻度虚化但仍保留可辨的层次;这是对白最经济的景别,亲近而不侵犯
promptEn: a mid-range lens framing from the chest up with the camera at the subject's eye height, expression and upper body posture equally readable so the tension or ease in the shoulders becomes a second layer beneath the face, the background softened but still holding recognisable depth, the most economical size for dialogue, intimate without intruding

promptZh: 主观镜头 (2)：使用主体既定视线方向的主观机位，保留轻微自然浮动与转向缓冲；不添加转头或行走动作
promptEn: Use a POV camera aligned with the scripted gaze, with subtle natural drift and eased turns; add no head turn or walking action

promptZh: 主观镜头：主观机位跟随正文既定视线，焦点随已有注意对象平滑调整；轻微浮动，不新增动作
promptEn: Use a POV camera following the scripted gaze and smoothly focusing on existing points of attention, with subtle drift and no added action

promptZh: 交叉穿行镜头：沿现有前景层次连续穿行，利用已有遮挡产生开合节奏；不新增层数或阻断关键信息
promptEn: Track continuously through existing foreground layers, using available occlusion for rhythmic reveal without adding layers or hiding essential information

promptZh: 低机位推进：低机位广角向前推进，利用现有地面纹理强调速度与透视；不新增天空或改变空间
promptEn: Push forward with a low wide-angle camera, emphasizing perspective through existing ground texture without adding sky or changing the space

promptZh: 低角压强镜头：采用低角广角和紧凑头顶留白强化透视压迫；保留原有光照与主体动作
promptEn: Use a low wide angle with tight headroom to emphasize perspective pressure while retaining lighting and subject action

promptZh: 低角度镜头(Low Angle):机位低于主体视线三十到八十厘米,以二十至四十度仰角用广角取景;垂直线条向画面上方汇聚,下颌、肩宽与身高被透视成倍夸张,头顶往往顶到画框边缘;上方留白成为背景,周围一切都被压在他的高度之下,权威感几乎是几何学意义上的
promptEn: the camera set thirty to eighty centimetres below the eyeline, angled twenty to forty degrees up on a wide lens, the verticals converging toward the top of the frame while perspective multiplies the jaw, the shoulder width and the height, the crown often touching the upper edge, everything else pressed below them, an authority that is almost geometric

promptZh: 体固机位：模拟体固机位，保持主体在画框中的位置相对稳定，背景变化仅来自原有运动
promptEn: Simulate a body-mounted camera with relatively stable subject framing; background motion follows only the scripted action

promptZh: 侧向切入镜头：从侧向快速切入并平稳急停，允许短暂运动模糊；节奏适配本段时长并保留原动作
promptEn: Rush in laterally and brake into stable framing, allowing brief motion blur while fitting the segment duration and retaining the scripted action

promptZh: 侧移窥视镜头：缓慢横移，透过已有前景缝隙观察主体，焦点保持在主体；不新增遮挡物
promptEn: Slide slowly sideways to view the subject through existing foreground gaps, holding subject focus without adding obstructions

promptZh: 侧背尾随镜头：从侧后方稳定跟随既定动作，前方保留观看空间，轻微自然浮动；不新增行走
promptEn: Follow the scripted action steadily from a rear-quarter view, leaving look room ahead with a subtle natural float; add no walking

promptZh: 俯仰镜头：固定机位平滑上仰或下俯，在既定环境内重新取景；起落缓冲服从原动作和时长
promptEn: Tilt smoothly from a fixed position within the existing setting, fitting start and end easing to the scripted action and duration

promptZh: 俯拍孤立镜头：用接近垂直的俯拍和不均衡留白强调主体占比；只利用现有空间，不添加空地
promptEn: Use a near-vertical high view and unbalanced negative space to reduce the subject visually, using only the existing setting

promptZh: 俯拍定格:高角度静止取景,四十五到七十度俯角,机位全程零运动;构图刻意强调几何关系,规整或散乱的排布本身成为要说的话;因为镜头拒绝移动,观众的视线得以在画面内部自由游走,把每一个位置关系读完
promptEn: a static high angle at forty-five to seventy degrees with absolutely no camera movement, the composition deliberately foregrounding geometry so that order or disorder becomes the statement itself, and because the shot refuses to move the eye is free to wander inside the frame and read every relationship in it

promptZh: 倾斜镜头：通过镜头滚转形成倾斜地平线，可保持倾角或随推进逐渐加深；不改变主体姿态
promptEn: Roll the camera to cant the horizon, either holding the angle or increasing it gradually during a push; retain subject posture

promptZh: 全景(Full Shot):广角取景,主体从头到脚完整入镜,头顶留白约一成,脚下绝不切掉;全部肢体语言——站姿、重心、手的位置、脚尖朝向——都成为可读的表演信息;地面与背景开始承担叙事职能,主体与空间的比例关系第一次被明确
promptEn: a wide lens with the entire figure in frame, roughly ten percent headroom and the feet never cropped, the full vocabulary of body language — stance, weight, where the hands rest, which way the toes point — becoming readable performance, the ground and background taking on narrative duty as the proportion between figure and space is stated for the first time

promptZh: 前景遮挡运镜：移动时利用已有近景产生柔焦遮挡与显露，主体保持清晰；遮挡节奏适配原内容，不新增前景
promptEn: Use existing near elements for soft occlusion and reveal during camera movement, keeping the subject clear and fitting the rhythm to the script

promptZh: 剪影决绝镜头：以稳定取景突出主体既有轮廓，保持动作与必要表情可读；不覆盖已选滤镜或强制新增逆光
promptEn: Hold stable framing to emphasize the existing silhouette while retaining readable action and essential expression; do not override the selected filter or add backlighting

promptZh: 匹配剪辑：只在正文已有切换点匹配前后画面的形状、方向或位置；没有切换点时保持连续取景，不新增剪切或时空跳跃
promptEn: Match shapes, directions or positions only across an existing scripted transition; otherwise retain a continuous view without adding a cut or a time-space jump

promptZh: 升降命运镜头：机位平稳升降，通过视角改变表现高度关系；幅度适配现有空间，不改变人物实际位置或增加停留时长
promptEn: Raise or lower the camera smoothly to reveal height relationships; fit available space without moving characters or adding hold duration

promptZh: 升降镜头 (2)：垂直升降并保持取景角度相对稳定，利用现有层次揭示纵深；幅度适配本段时长和空间
promptEn: Pedestal vertically with a relatively stable viewing angle, revealing existing depth within the available duration and space

promptZh: 升降镜头：垂直平稳改变机位高度，在平视与俯视之间过渡；保留实际空间关系和动作
promptEn: Change camera height smoothly between eye level and a higher view while retaining actual spatial relations and action

promptZh: 压迫式逼近:长焦机位以几乎察觉不到的速度持续缩短距离,压缩后的背景像一层不可穿透的平面贴在主体身后,没有任何后退余地;头顶与两侧的留白被一寸寸吃掉,构图从中景收到近景;整个过程没有剪辑也没有停顿,心理压强完全由这份不肯停下的接近累积而成
promptEn: a telephoto camera creeping closer at a barely perceptible rate, the compressed background standing like an impenetrable plane behind the subject with no room to retreat, the headroom and side margins eaten away inch by inch from medium shot to close-up, no cut and no pause, the pressure built entirely from an approach that will not stop

promptZh: 双主体摆渡镜头：在正文已有关注对象之间平滑横移和重新取景，节奏服从原内容；不足两个对象时仅做小幅横移，不新增人物
promptEn: Move laterally and reframe between existing points of attention at the scripted pace; with fewer than two subjects use a small lateral move without adding people

promptZh: 反向包抄镜头：围绕既定主体从侧后向前方平滑绕行，幅度适配现有空间和时长，不增加末端停顿
promptEn: Orbit smoothly from behind toward the front of the existing subject, fitting space and duration without adding a final hold

promptZh: 反向拉出揭示：从较紧取景连续平稳后拉，逐步揭示正文已有环境层次；幅度适配空间，不新增反转或延长落幅
promptEn: Pull back continuously from a tight view to reveal existing environmental layers, fitting the space without adding a reversal or extending the ending

promptZh: 反打对峙镜头：仅在正文已有正反打段落中保持视线轴线与取景衔接；其他情况下连续重新取景，不新增剪辑或缩短台词停顿
promptEn: Maintain eyeline continuity within existing shot-reverse-shot passages; otherwise reframe continuously without adding cuts or shortening dialogue pauses

promptZh: 变焦窒息镜头：前推与反向变焦协调，使主体相对大小稳定、背景透视产生拉伸感；适配原动作和时长，不改变声音
promptEn: Coordinate a forward dolly and reverse zoom to stabilize subject scale and stretch apparent background depth; retain action, duration and sound

promptZh: 变焦镜头(Zoom):机位完全不动,只由变焦环连续改变焦段;推向长焦时纵深被逐渐压平,远处的层次像贴纸一样叠到主体身后,背景虚化加深;反向拉到广角时空间被撑开,透视重新变得夸张;因为观察点始终未变,画面呈现出与推轨截然不同的、带有窥视意味的机械感
promptEn: a static camera with a continuous optical zoom and no physical movement at all, pushing to telephoto flattens the depth until the far layers stack up like paper behind the subject and the bokeh deepens, pulling back to wide re-expands the space and exaggerates the perspective again, the fixed viewpoint giving it a detached, surveillance-like quality quite unlike a dolly

promptZh: 变速运镜：镜头移动速度从慢到快或由快到慢连续变化，变化点服从正文既有动作，不改动作播放速度或段落时长
promptEn: Vary camera travel smoothly from slow to fast or fast to slow at existing action beats without retiming the action or segment

promptZh: 后备箱镜头：采用低位向上取景，利用正文已有开口作为内框；不存在开口时仅保留低角度，不新增容器或俯身动作
promptEn: Use a low upward view and an existing opening as an inner frame; without one retain only the low angle, adding no container or leaning action

promptZh: 后撤疏离镜头：镜头极慢后拉，逐步扩大环境在画框中的占比；主体按原文行动，不固定人物或新增持续时长
promptEn: Pull back very slowly to increase the environment's share of the frame; retain the scripted subject action without imposing stillness or extra duration

promptZh: 回撤揭示镜头：从紧特写快速后拉，揭示已有的整体环境；收尾平稳，速度服从本段时长，不新增剧情反转
promptEn: Pull back quickly from a tight detail to reveal the existing environment, settling smoothly within the segment without adding a plot reversal

promptZh: 大特写：以微距或长焦紧密取景现有关键细节，浅景深突出纹理；保留原有光照和材质
promptEn: Use a macro or long-lens tight view of an existing key detail, emphasizing texture with shallow focus while retaining lighting and materials

promptZh: 子弹时间：以平滑环绕和稳定主体构图表现子弹时间般的空间感；不冻结动作、不拉长时间、不新增悬浮颗粒
promptEn: Suggest bullet-time spatial emphasis through smooth orbiting and stable subject framing, without freezing or stretching action or adding suspended particles

promptZh: 定格凝视镜头：镜头固定，保持稳定构图与焦点；主体动作、表情与台词完全按正文进行，不规定额外停留秒数
promptEn: Lock the camera, framing and focus while retaining all scripted action, expression and dialogue without requiring additional hold time

promptZh: 定格帧：以稳定机位与清晰落幅表现定格感；保持原有运动和时间连续性，不新增静帧、文字、声音或剪切
promptEn: Suggest a freeze-frame emphasis through stable framing and a clear ending while preserving motion and continuity; add no still frames, text, sound or cuts

promptZh: 希区柯克变焦：沿光轴推拉并以反向变焦补偿主体大小，形成背景纵深伸缩的视错觉；幅度适配原动作和时长
promptEn: Dolly along the lens axis with a compensating reverse zoom to create apparent depth expansion or compression, fitted to existing action and duration

promptZh: 弧线跟进:机位沿一段九十到一百八十度的弧线一边缩短距离一边侧移,主体在画框中从偏侧缓慢滑向中心,朝向随之改变;背景以弧线的角速度连续横扫,空间在靠近的同时被展开;速度全程平稳不带顿挫,靠近的过程本身像一次试探性的接近
promptEn: the camera arcs ninety to a hundred and eighty degrees, closing distance and sliding sideways at once, the subject drifting from the edge of frame toward the center as their orientation turns into view, the background sweeping continuously behind, the space opening even as it tightens, the whole approach smooth and tentative

promptZh: 微距失控镜头：微距取景现有细节，浅景深自然响应原有细微位移；不新增汗珠或颤动
promptEn: Frame an existing detail in macro with shallow focus responding naturally to scripted small movements; add no sweat or tremor

promptZh: 快速推进变焦：快速变焦推近，短暂径向运动模糊后稳定落幅；不固定秒数，保留本段完整动作
promptEn: Zoom in rapidly with brief radial motion blur before settling, retaining the full segment action without fixed timing

promptZh: 悬停审视镜头：保持距离并做细微侧向浮动与角度调整，以略偏中心的构图持续观察，主体按原文行动
promptEn: Hold distance with subtle lateral float and angle adjustments, observing through slightly off-center framing while retaining scripted subject action

promptZh: 慢摇预兆镜头：固定机位缓慢横摇，依序展示正文已有信息，起落幅服从原节奏；不新增空场、威胁或停顿
promptEn: Pan slowly from a fixed position across existing information, fitting the scripted rhythm without adding an empty scene, threat or hold

promptZh: 手持崩溃镜头：贴近主体手持跟随既定动作，使用克制的不规则晃动和短暂焦点调整表现失稳；不改变呼吸或动作
promptEn: Follow scripted action closely with restrained irregular handheld movement and brief focus correction; retain breathing and performance

promptZh: 手持镜头：自然手持微晃、轻微水平修正与跟随缓冲，焦点及时回到主体；不规定延迟秒数
promptEn: Use natural handheld micro-shake, slight horizon correction and eased following with prompt subject refocusing, without fixed delay timing

promptZh: 抽帧拖影：用克制的运动拖影呈现抽帧质感，保持全部动作、台词与时间连续性；不实际抽掉动作帧或改光照
promptEn: Suggest step-print texture through restrained motion trails while preserving action, dialogue and temporal continuity; do not drop action frames or change lighting

promptZh: 抽离镜头：镜头缓慢远离并逐渐减速，按原片段节奏收束；不要求主体静止或额外落幅
promptEn: Drift away with gradually decreasing camera speed, settling within the scripted rhythm without requiring subject stillness or additional hold time

promptZh: 拉焦：在现有近远关注点之间平滑转移焦点，构图稳定；不存在第二焦点时保持主体清晰，不新增对象或间距
promptEn: Rack focus smoothly between existing near and far points with stable framing; if no second point exists keep the subject clear without adding objects or distance

promptZh: 拉焦转移镜头：保持构图，在正文已有前后景焦点间柔和交接；节奏适配原内容，不新增主体或空间间隔
promptEn: Hold framing while handing focus gently between existing depth planes, fitting the script without adding subjects or spatial gaps

promptZh: 拉镜：沿直线平稳后撤，逐步扩大现有环境取景并增加可读纵深；收尾服从原时长
promptEn: Dolly back smoothly in a straight line to widen the existing view and reveal depth, settling within the scripted duration

promptZh: 拉镜头：从近景向较宽取景平稳后撤，依次展示已有环境；不强制新增空旷空间或固定景别跨度
promptEn: Pull back smoothly from a close view to a wider frame, revealing existing surroundings without requiring empty space or a fixed scale change

promptZh: 推近压迫镜头：以长焦浅景深缓慢逼近既定主体，聚焦关键表情，运动平稳；不新增呼吸、颤动或紧张表演
promptEn: Creep toward the existing subject with a long lens and shallow focus, emphasizing scripted expression without adding breath, tremor or tense performance

promptZh: 推镜(Push In):起幅中景,机位与主体视线等高,标准焦段;机位沿光轴匀速向前推进,全程不改变焦距,主体在画框中的高度稳定增长直至撑满近景;画框两侧的环境层次被一寸寸挤出画外,可供逃逸的视觉空间被逐步收走;景深随距离缩短而变薄,背景由可读退化为色块,焦点始终咬住眼睛,压迫与沉浸随距离同步收紧
promptEn: cinematic dolly push in from a medium shot at eye level on a standard lens, the camera gliding forward along the axis at a constant speed with the focal length locked, the subject growing steadily until they fill the frame while the surrounding layers are squeezed out of the edges, depth of field thinning until the background dissolves into soft colour, focus pinned to the eyes, intimate and increasingly airless

promptZh: 推镜头：在所选范围内由中景连续推进至近景，机位沿光轴平稳前移、焦距不变，主体在画框中持续变大，形成可辨识的推进；覆盖本范围原有固定或横移运镜，不以人物走近代替机位前移。保留原稿动作及必须呈现的人物、持物、口型和交互，焦点跟随既有主体与必要细节，不强制仅保留脸部。
promptEn: Within the selected range, make a continuous dolly push from a medium shot toward a close-up, moving the camera forward along its optical axis with a fixed focal length so the subject visibly grows in frame. Override original static or lateral camera directions in this range; subject movement toward the camera is not a substitute for the dolly. Retain scripted actions and required people, held props, speaking mouths and interactions, focusing on the existing subject and necessary details rather than only a face.

promptZh: 摇镜：固定机位平稳横摇，依序呈现已有空间，起落缓冲适配片段节奏，不规定停留时长
promptEn: Pan smoothly from a fixed position across the existing space, fitting start and end easing to the segment without fixed holds

promptZh: 摇镜头：沿水平方向缓慢横摇，按正文既有信息顺序取景，平滑落到当前关注点，不新增停顿
promptEn: Pan slowly across the scripted information in its existing order, settling smoothly on the current point of attention without added pauses

promptZh: 斜向俯冲镜头:机位从高处沿三十至四十五度的斜线向下俯冲而入,下落与前推同时发生,速度持续增加;地面在画框下缘迅速涌上来,两侧的形体从画框边缘高速掠过;末端或急停在主体面前,或贴着头顶掠过继续前行;攻击性来自这条不给人反应时间的直线
promptEn: the camera dives in along a thirty to forty-five degree diagonal from above, descending and pushing forward at once with speed still building, the ground surging up into the bottom of the frame while shapes tear past both edges, ending either in a hard stop in front of the subject or skimming over their head and carrying on, the aggression coming from a trajectory that allows no time to react

promptZh: 无缝穿越转场：利用正文已有遮挡形成连续穿越感；仅在已有转场点匹配前后运动，没有转场时不新增剪切或更换空间
promptEn: Use existing occlusion for a continuous through-shot impression; match motion only at scripted transitions, otherwise add no cut or change of setting

promptZh: 极速推进镜头：快速推进到较紧取景，短暂运动模糊后平稳收束；速度适配本段时长，保留动作信息
promptEn: Push rapidly toward a tighter frame with brief motion blur and a stable finish, fitting segment duration and retaining action information

promptZh: 滑轨镜头(Dolly):机位坐在直线轨道上匀速滑行,没有任何加减速与抖动,水平误差控制在肉眼不可察的范围;前景与背景以严格的速度差产生视差,空间纵深被这份差值刻画出来;构图在移动中始终保持平衡,画面呈现出一种被精确控制的、近乎机械的优雅
promptEn: a smooth dolly move along a straight track at perfectly constant speed with no acceleration and no shake, the horizon dead level, foreground and background separating through precisely graded parallax that carves out the depth of the space, the composition staying balanced throughout, controlled and almost mechanically elegant

promptZh: 特写(Close-up):中长焦取景,面部占据画框约百分之八十,发顶轻微出画,下巴留出少量空间;大光圈把景深压到只覆盖眼睛所在的一层,鼻尖与耳廓已经开始发虚,背景彻底化为色块;焦点绝对锁在近侧眼睛的睫毛上,所有信息都由瞳孔与嘴角承担
promptEn: a long lens close-up with the face filling roughly eighty percent of the frame, the top of the head cropped slightly and a little air left under the chin, the aperture wide enough that only the plane of the eyes is sharp while the nose tip and ear already soften and the background dissolves entirely, focus pinned to the lashes of the near eye

promptZh: 特写定格：固定特写机位、焦点和构图突出既有表情或细节；人物继续按原文动作，不新增末尾停留
promptEn: Hold close-up camera position, focus and framing on an existing expression or detail while retaining scripted movement without adding an ending hold

promptZh: 环绕升格：采用平滑舒缓的环绕突出主体细节，角度与速度适配片段；不改变动作速度、光照或总时长
promptEn: Use a smooth leisurely orbit to emphasize subject detail, fitting the arc and speed to the segment without retiming action or changing lighting

promptZh: 环绕眩晕镜头：环绕中叠加细微变焦和地平线倾斜，保持主体可读；绕行幅度适配空间和时长，不要求整圈
promptEn: Combine orbiting with subtle zoom and horizon roll while keeping the subject readable; fit the arc to available space and duration without requiring a full circle

promptZh: 环绕镜头(Orbit):机位以主体为圆心沿固定半径的圆弧持续绕行,主体始终锁在画面中心且大小不变,朝向随环绕角度自然改变;背景在身后连续横向滑动并旋转,被拉成流动的环带;景深保持浅,背景虚化成连续的光斑;张力随绕行角度一圈圈累积
promptEn: the camera orbits the subject on a fixed radius, the figure locked dead center at an unchanging size while their orientation turns naturally through the arc, the background sliding and rotating behind them into a flowing band of bokeh, shallow depth of field throughout, tension accumulating with every degree of the circle

promptZh: 甩镜：快速横摇，中段允许短暂方向性运动模糊，起落幅清晰；不新增剪切或空间跳转
promptEn: Whip pan with brief directional blur between readable start and end frames; add no cut or spatial jump

promptZh: 甩镜转场：只在正文已有转场中衔接同向甩镜；无转场时采用连续快速横摇，不新增场景或剪切
promptEn: Match same-direction whip motion only across scripted transitions; otherwise use a continuous whip pan without adding scenes or cuts

promptZh: 移轴微缩：通过选择性清晰带与高角度表现移轴微缩视觉感；不改变实际尺度、主体动作或已选滤镜
promptEn: Use selective focus and a high angle for a tilt-shift miniature appearance without changing actual scale, subject action or the selected filter

promptZh: 移镜(Truck)：机位平行横移，以稳定视差呈现现有空间层次；若主体原本在移动，可按其既有速度跟随，否则围绕静止主体横向取景。保持原动作、位置关系和所有必要人物道具，不新增前景层或主体运动。
promptEn: Truck the camera laterally with steady parallax through the existing space. Follow the subject at its existing speed if already moving; otherwise move the camera across a stationary subject. Preserve actions, spatial relationships and required people and props without adding foreground layers or subject motion.

promptZh: 移镜头：镜头作平稳的横向位移；对正文已有的行进可保持等速平行跟随，静止主体则保持原位。通过现有背景的连续视差呈现空间，不改变动作节奏、速度或路径。
promptEn: Move the camera laterally at a steady pace. Track parallel to movement already described, while leaving stationary subjects in place. Reveal the existing background through continuous parallax without changing action timing, speed or trajectory.

promptZh: 稳定器跟拍(Gimbal Follow)：使用平滑稳定的机位运动跟随正文已有的主体动作，保留必要的空间和交互信息；主体静止时仅平滑调整机位，不要求主体走动。移动中可轻微改变观察角度，始终遵守原动作节奏与方向。
promptEn: Use smooth stabilized camera motion to follow actions already described, retaining required space and interaction information. For a stationary subject, adjust only the camera and do not require walking. Vary the viewing angle gently while preserving the original action timing and direction.

promptZh: 空镜余韵镜头：按正文既定落幅保持机位；仅当原文主体已出画时保留空景，不新增离场动作或延长停留
promptEn: Hold the camera for the scripted ending; retain an empty frame only if the subject already exits, without adding an exit or extending duration

promptZh: 穿越机镜头：广角第一人称连续运动，路径仅使用现有可通行空间；不新增开口、强穿实体或改变场景
promptEn: Use continuous wide-angle first-person travel only through existing passable space, without adding openings, passing through solid objects or changing the setting

promptZh: 穿越运镜：以广角通过正文已有开口或缝隙，平滑展示另一侧已有空间；路径不可通行时保持当前侧取景
promptEn: Use a wide view through an existing passable opening to reveal its existing far side; if passage is unavailable retain the current-side view

promptZh: 穿越障碍镜头：沿现有可通行路径向主体推进，利用已有遮挡自然收放视野；不新增障碍或要求层数
promptEn: Push toward the subject along an existing passable path, using available occlusion without adding obstacles or requiring a layer count

promptZh: 突停凝视镜头：持续运动后快速稳定机位，保持原有动作与台词，停顿仅使用原片段允许的时间
promptEn: Brake camera movement into stable framing while retaining scripted action and dialogue; any hold stays within the available segment time

promptZh: 纵深穿堂镜头：沿现有空间纵深平稳推进，利用已有线条和层次组织居中透视；不新增通道或暗区
promptEn: Advance smoothly into existing depth, using available lines and layers for centered perspective without adding a passage or dark area

promptZh: 航拍镜头：以高位俯视平缓移动，展示现有场景规模与主体位置；高度和幅度服从实际空间，不新增景观
promptEn: Move smoothly from a raised downward view to show the existing scene scale and subject position, fitting available space without adding landscape

promptZh: 节奏点爆发镜头：先缓慢推进，在正文既有动作节拍处加快机位运动；不新增节拍或规定固定秒数
promptEn: Begin with a slow push and accelerate camera travel at an existing scripted beat, without adding a beat or fixed timing

promptZh: 荷兰角渐进(Progressive Dutch Tilt):画面从完全水平的起幅开始,随着镜头推进,滚转角以匀速持续加大,从零度一路倾到十五至三十度,中途绝不回正;观众在前半段几乎察觉不到倾斜,直到某一刻突然意识到画面已经歪了;倾斜与推进同步进行,失衡感与逼近感彼此叠加,危机是被慢慢拧出来的
promptEn: the frame begins perfectly level and, as the shot pushes in, the roll increases at a steady rate from zero to fifteen or thirty degrees and never corrects back, the tilt imperceptible through the first half until the viewer suddenly registers that the image has gone crooked, the cant and the push advancing together so that the unease is slowly wrung out rather than announced

promptZh: 贴地掠行镜头:机位压到离地二十厘米以内,用超广角高速前掠;地面纹理在前景被拉成连续的流线,快门带出明显拖影;主体在中景处保持相对稳定,天地比例被极端压缩;速度不是靠剪辑给的,而是靠贴地这一点距离逼出来的
promptEn: the camera drops to within twenty centimetres of the ground and rushes forward on an ultra wide lens, the ground texture pulled into continuous streaks in the foreground with heavy shutter smear, the subject holding steady in the mid-ground, the ratio of ground to sky crushed, the speed coming not from cutting but from that last few centimetres of clearance

promptZh: 超远景：采用宽阔远景和较小主体占比展示现有环境规模；不新增景观或改变天气
promptEn: Use an extreme long view with a small subject to show the existing environment's scale without adding landscape or changing weather

promptZh: 跟镜(Follow)：对正文已有的行进，从主体后方以稳定距离跟随，保留本段必须呈现的交互、道具及空间关系；若后方机位会挡住必要信息则适度调整角度。静止主体不新增行进动作。
promptEn: Follow movement already described from a stable distance behind the subject, keeping required interactions, props and spatial relationships visible. Adjust the viewing angle if a rear position would obscure necessary information. Do not add travel to a stationary subject.

promptZh: 跟镜头：机位稳定跟随正文已有的主体运动，距离与角度以不丢失必要信息为限保持一致；沿用原速度、动作和背景空间。静止主体保持静止，不额外安排走动或加速。
promptEn: Track subject movement already present in the narrative, maintaining distance and angle where required information remains visible. Preserve the original speed, actions and environment. Keep stationary subjects still and introduce no travel or acceleration.

promptZh: 跟随沉浸镜头：在正文已有行进时，以接近主体视线高度的稳定器机位近距离跟随，轻微保留既有步伐的节奏；不改变原路线、速度和交互。主体静止时保持其静止，仅用近距离稳定取景呈现沉浸感。
promptEn: When the narrative already includes travel, follow closely with a stabilized camera near the subject eye level, retaining subtle rhythm from the existing steps. Preserve the original path, speed and interactions. For a stationary subject, use close stable framing without making the subject move.

promptZh: 过肩镜头：利用正文已有前景人物的肩背作为局部框景，聚焦既有关注对象并保持视线轴线；无前景人物时不新增人物
promptEn: Use an existing foreground shoulder as partial framing, focusing on the scripted subject and retaining the eyeline axis; add no foreground person

promptZh: 远景(Long Shot):主体在画框中只占百分之十五到二十五,大量空间在四周展开;前中后景层次分明,质感、天气与光线成为主要的情绪来源;主体的动作只剩下轮廓可读,表情完全交给观众想象;留白越大,那份被世界甩在外面的感觉就越确切
promptEn: the figure occupying only fifteen to twenty-five percent of the frame with space opening on every side, foreground, middle and distance clearly layered so texture, weather and light become the primary source of emotion, the action readable only as silhouette with expression left entirely to the viewer, the larger the emptiness the more certain the sense of being left outside

promptZh: 退让式让位镜头：后撤同时留出一侧画面空间，配合正文既有入画或注意力转移；不新增对象或入场动作
promptEn: Retreat while opening one side of the frame for an existing entrance or attention shift; add no object or entrance action

promptZh: 速度斜坡：通过机位移动速度的平滑变化表现速度斜坡，变化点依据原动作；不改变动作播放速度或段落总时长
promptEn: Suggest a speed ramp through smooth changes in camera travel at scripted action beats without retiming performance or the segment

promptZh: 长焦压缩人群：长焦压缩正文已有前后层次，保留主体清晰与原有密度；不新增人群或调整实际间距
promptEn: Use telephoto compression of existing depth layers while retaining subject clarity and actual density; add no crowd or spatial rearrangement

promptZh: 长焦抽离镜头：以较远长焦视点压缩现有纵深、突出疏离感；仅利用已有前景，不新增横穿形体
promptEn: Use a distant telephoto view to compress existing depth and suggest detachment, using only existing foreground without adding passing figures

promptZh: 长镜头调度：以连续机位运动跟随正文已有调度，平滑调整距离、高度与朝向；不新增走位或空间转换
promptEn: Follow existing blocking in a continuous take with smooth changes of distance, height and heading, without adding movement or setting changes

promptZh: 顶视旋落镜头：从高位俯视平稳下降并绕轴微旋，逐渐趋近平视；幅度适配现有空间及本段时长
promptEn: Descend smoothly from a high downward view with gentle axial rotation toward eye level, fitting existing space and segment duration

promptZh: 高机位俯拍(High Angle):机位架到主体头顶以上,以三十到六十度俯角向下取景,主体被压在画框下部并被大面积地面包围;俯角削弱了垂直体量,肩线与头顶成为主要轮廓;画面内所有位置关系一览无余,观众被放在一个居高临下、不介入的观察位上
promptEn: the camera raised above head height looking down at thirty to sixty degrees, the subject pressed into the lower frame and surrounded by an expanse of ground, the downward angle stripping away their vertical presence so shoulders and crown become the dominant shape, every position laid bare, the viewer placed above the scene and outside it

promptZh: 高角度镜头(High Angle):机位高于主体,以三十到五十度俯角向下取景,主体被安排在画框下三分之一;俯角压缩了身高与体量,肩线与头顶成为主要轮廓,背景变成大面积的地面;主体在画面中无处可藏,所有位置关系一览无余,被动与脆弱不需要表演就已经写在构图里
promptEn: the camera raised above the subject and angled thirty to fifty degrees down, the figure placed in the lower third of the frame, the angle compressing their height and mass so shoulders and crown become the dominant shape while the ground fills the background, nowhere in frame left to hide, passivity written into the composition before any performance begins

promptZh: 鸟瞰镜头(Bird's-eye View):机位垂直于地面正上方,俯角九十度;所有立体的形体被压成平面图形,只剩位置、方向与色块;地面的规则纹理与线条成为构图的网格,主体在网格上像棋子一样被安排;透视消失之后,几何秩序与调度关系取而代之成为画面的主语
promptEn: the camera directly overhead in a full ninety degree top-down, every volume flattened into graphic shape leaving only position, direction and colour, the regular lines and patterns of the ground becoming the grid of the composition with the figures arranged on it like pieces on a board, perspective gone and geometry taking over as the subject of the image

promptZh: 三分法构图:把画框横竖各三等分,主体落在其中一条竖线或某个交点上而不是正中;视线朝向的一侧留出更多空间,让主体有可看向的余地;地平线压在上或下三分线上,天地比例不做对半分;整体均衡而不呆板,最接近自然的观看习惯
promptEn: the frame divided into thirds both ways with the subject set on one of the vertical lines or an intersection rather than dead center, more space left open on the side they face so their gaze has somewhere to go, the horizon resting on the upper or lower third rather than splitting the frame in half, balanced without being rigid

promptZh: 中轴破缺构图：利用现有结构形成近似对称，在取景上让主体偏离中轴；不移动人物或重排环境
promptEn: Use existing structure for approximate symmetry while framing the subject off-axis; do not move people or rearrange the environment

promptZh: 临界跨步构图：利用现有明暗或结构分界组织跨界构图，突出主体与边界的关系；不新增跨步或改变姿态
promptEn: Frame the subject against an existing tonal or structural boundary to emphasize a threshold relationship without adding a step or changing posture

promptZh: 临空摆荡构图：用上部主体、下部留白和弧线动势表现悬停感；不新增腾空、摆荡或改变支撑关系
promptEn: Suggest suspension through upper-frame subject placement, lower negative space and curved visual flow without adding flight, swinging or changing support

promptZh: 交叉火线构图：利用已有线条与方向关系在主体周围形成交叉视觉焦点；不新增光迹或要求主体静止
promptEn: Use existing lines and directions to form a crossing visual focus around the subject, without adding light trails or requiring stillness

promptZh: 低机位仰拍构图：低角度紧凑取景，减少头顶留白，利用现有垂直线强调透视；保留环境内容
promptEn: Use tight low-angle framing and reduced headroom with existing verticals for perspective emphasis, retaining environmental content

promptZh: 低饱和静爆构图：以低饱和区域衬托现有小面积视觉重点，保持稳定画框；不冻结动作或覆盖独立滤镜要求
promptEn: Use muted surrounding regions to emphasize an existing small visual accent within stable framing; do not freeze action or override the separate filter

promptZh: 余光联结构图：根据正文既有人物朝向与间距组织偏侧视觉联系；不新增人物、不禁止原有对视、不抹去背景结构
promptEn: Frame peripheral relationships using existing orientations and spacing, without adding people, preventing scripted eye contact or erasing background structure

promptZh: 侧坐失衡构图：以偏侧主体和不均衡下方留白表现失衡感；原有坐姿、站姿和重心保持不变
promptEn: Suggest imbalance through off-center framing and unequal lower negative space, retaining the scripted posture and weight distribution

promptZh: 侧翼失重构图：将主体偏置于画框一侧，利用当前场景已有的简洁区域形成不对称留白与外倾重心；保留本段所有必要对象和动作信息，不为维持失衡而移除叙事元素。
promptEn: Place the subject toward one edge and use existing uncluttered areas for asymmetrical negative space and an off-center visual weight. Keep every required object and action visible; do not remove narrative elements to maintain imbalance.

promptZh: 倒影主叙构图：仅在已有反射面时突出其中影像，保持真实光学对应；没有反射面时以偏侧取景突出主体，不新增镜面
promptEn: Emphasize the image in an existing reflective surface with physically consistent reflection; without one use off-center subject framing and add no mirror

promptZh: 光缝塑形构图：用紧窄明暗区域突出既有关键细节，保留叙事必要信息；不强制新光源或覆盖已选滤镜
promptEn: Use a narrow tonal area to emphasize existing key detail while retaining essential information; add no required light source and do not override the filter

promptZh: 冷暖断层构图：以现有冷暖区域组织清晰色彩边界，主体位置保持原样；不新建空间或覆盖滤镜
promptEn: Organize existing warm-cool regions around a clear visual boundary, retaining subject position and the selected filter without changing the space

promptZh: 前后景失焦反转构图:刻意把焦点交给背景,而让本该是主体的前景保持虚化;观众的眼睛习惯性去找清晰的那一层,却发现叙事重心并不在那里;虚化的前景仍占据画框的主要面积与视觉重量,清晰与重要在这里被拆开,不安由此产生
promptEn: focus deliberately handed to the background while the foreground that ought to be the subject is left soft, the eye instinctively seeking the sharp plane only to find the narrative weight is not there, the defocused foreground still occupying the greater area and visual mass, sharpness and importance pulled apart to unsettling effect

promptZh: 前景遮挡构图：利用已有近景进行柔焦遮挡，通过剩余视野展示主体；不新增或移动遮挡物
promptEn: Use existing near elements for soft foreground occlusion and frame the subject through the remaining view without adding or moving obstructions

promptZh: 单人特写构图：紧密取景正文既定关注人物的面部，浅景深突出眼神；保留其他人物的剧情存在及已选滤镜
promptEn: Frame the existing focal character tightly with shallow focus on the eyes, retaining other characters' narrative presence and the selected filter

promptZh: 压迫边角构图：主体取景偏向角落，以现有暗部或结构的画面占比产生压迫；不新增围挡或改变通行关系
promptEn: Frame the subject toward a corner, using the visual weight of existing shadows or structure without adding barriers or changing passage

promptZh: 双人平衡构图：正文已有两位关注人物时，通过取景平衡两者视觉重量；人数不足时平衡主体与现有环境，不新增人物或改变站位
promptEn: Balance the visual weight of two existing focal characters; otherwise balance the subject against the existing setting without adding people or changing positions

promptZh: 双层窗景构图：仅利用已有透明界面的反射与透视形成前后层次；不足两层时使用现有层数，不新增玻璃或改变人物位置
promptEn: Layer reflection and depth only through existing transparent surfaces; use the available layers without adding glass or repositioning people

promptZh: 双窗对位构图：利用已有开口或明暗区块组织并置框景，保持原有人数和位置；不新增窗口
promptEn: Use existing openings or tonal blocks for paired visual framing, retaining the actual people and positions without adding windows

promptZh: 双轴冲撞构图：利用现有横纵方向关系形成略偏中心的视觉交点；不新增逼近、碰撞或运动轨迹
promptEn: Use existing horizontal and depth relationships for an off-center visual intersection without adding approach, collision or movement paths

promptZh: 反向通道人像构图：突出正文已有方向对比，通过虚实与取景区分主体和背景；不新增人流或改变移动方向
promptEn: Emphasize existing directional contrast through focus and framing, without adding a crowd or changing movement directions

promptZh: 回望断点构图：根据正文既有朝向在主体身后保留较多画面空间；不新增回头、离开或停顿动作
promptEn: Leave more framing space behind the subject according to the existing orientation without adding a backward glance, departure or pause

promptZh: 回身格挡构图：围绕正文已有肢体方向与形体关系组织对抗性斜线；不新增转身、格挡、袭击或威胁
promptEn: Organize diagonal visual tension around existing limb directions and shapes without adding turns, blocking, attacks or threats

promptZh: 坠物压境构图：以已有上方结构或暗部的画面占比形成上重下轻的视觉压力；不新增坠物、碎屑或躲闪
promptEn: Use the visual weight of existing upper structure or shadow for top-heavy pressure without adding falling objects, debris or evasion

promptZh: 多点视线牵引构图：利用正文已有目光与姿态分配注意力，保持原有人数与朝向；不强制多个主体或改变视线
promptEn: Distribute attention across existing gazes and poses, retaining the actual number of people and their orientations without adding subjects or redirecting eyelines

promptZh: 失焦情绪构图：以轻微离焦与柔和轮廓表现朦胧视觉，散景只来自已有光源；不新增光源或改变剧情时态
promptEn: Use slight defocus and soft contours with bokeh only from existing light sources, without adding sources or changing narrative time

promptZh: 夹层观察构图：利用已有横向层次形成上下夹层取景，主体清晰可辨；不新增压迫结构
promptEn: Frame the subject between existing horizontal layers while keeping them legible, without adding enclosing structure

promptZh: 对角线构图:主要形体沿画框的对角方向排布,与水平垂直的框架形成明显夹角;斜线天然带有速度与不稳定属性,画面因此始终处在一种将倒未倒的动势中;对角线的两端最好都顶到画框边缘,让张力贯穿整幅而不被中断
promptEn: the principal shapes arranged along a diagonal set at a clear angle to the horizontal and vertical of the frame, the slant carrying inherent speed and instability so the image sits permanently in a state of about to topple, both ends of the diagonal reaching the edges so the tension runs uninterrupted across the whole

promptZh: 尾迹疾撤构图：围绕原文已有离场方向与残留细节组织边缘取景；未发生离场时只保留方向留白，不新增颗粒或光迹
promptEn: Frame existing exit direction and residual detail near the edge; without a scripted exit use directional negative space only, adding no particles or trails

promptZh: 局部肢体构图：在正文已描述的肢体动作或细节中选择叙事重心，以局部取景强调该细节；同时保留本段必须呈现的人物、说话口型、道具及交互关系，需要时放宽取景，不强制裁掉其他必要信息。
promptEn: Emphasize an existing bodily action or detail with close framing. Keep every person, speaking mouth, prop and interaction required by this segment visible; widen the frame when needed rather than cropping out required narrative information.

promptZh: 层次纵深构图：区分现有近中远层次的虚实与视觉重量；不为凑足层数新增内容或改变位置
promptEn: Differentiate focus and visual weight across available depth layers without adding content to meet a layer count or changing positions

promptZh: 居中对称构图：从所选范围第一帧起，将原稿主主体自身置于画框竖直中轴（画幅宽度50%处）。人物以脸部和躯干中线对齐；既有多人主主体则以该主体组为中心，保留组内互动。不要把背景家具或环境与主主体合算中心；背景处于左右侧，不能挤偏主体。覆盖原文偏左、偏右或三分线的画面位置描述。仅通过机位与取景调整，保留真实位置、既定姿态、动作及必须呈现的持物，不新增人物移动或站坐变化，不镜像、复制或移动场景元素。
promptEn: From the first frame of the selected range, center the script's primary subject itself on the frame's vertical centerline, at 50% of frame width. For a person, align the face and torso centerline; for an existing group of primary subjects, center that group and preserve its interactions. Do not combine background furniture or surroundings with the primary subject to calculate the center. Keep the background to either side without pushing the subject off-center. Override original left, right or rule-of-thirds screen placement. Adjust only camera position and framing; preserve actual positions, scripted postures and actions, and necessary held objects. Do not add subject movement or posture changes, or mirror, duplicate or move scene elements.

promptZh: 引导线构图：利用正文已有透视边缘或明暗线条引导视线到主体；不新增线条结构或光带
promptEn: Lead the eye toward the subject through existing perspective edges or tonal boundaries without adding structures or light bands

promptZh: 弧线包抄构图：利用现有形体或线条形成弧形视觉包裹，保持真实位置与动作；不新增包抄者或改变退路
promptEn: Use existing shapes or lines for curved visual enclosure while retaining actual positions and action, without adding encircling figures or altering exits

promptZh: 影子先行构图：仅在已有影子时增加其画面占比，与真实主体和光照保持一致；不新增威胁或延迟出场
promptEn: Give an existing shadow more visual weight, consistent with the real subject and lighting; add no threat or delayed entrance

promptZh: 掩体探身构图：透过已有遮挡边缘观察主体，留出原朝向的画面空间；不新增掩体、探身或威胁
promptEn: View the subject past existing occlusion and leave room in the scripted direction, without adding cover, leaning or a threat

promptZh: 斜雨切片构图：利用已有斜向线条形成条带节奏，必要时仅通过取景角度强调斜线；不新增降雨或覆盖滤镜
promptEn: Use existing diagonal lines for rhythmic bands, emphasizing them through framing if needed; add no rain and do not override the filter

promptZh: 斜面静置构图：通过倾斜取景强化现有斜线与主体方向的对比；不改变地面坡度或要求人物静止
promptEn: Use angled framing to emphasize existing directional contrast without changing ground slope or requiring the subject to remain still

promptZh: 断层跃迁构图：利用已有高低层次组织上下分区，突出主体与纵深关系；不新增落差、腾空或跳跃
promptEn: Frame existing height layers as upper and lower regions, emphasizing subject-depth relations without adding a drop, airborne pose or leap

promptZh: 旋身反制构图：围绕原有姿态或运动方向组织弧线动势，拖影仅响应既有动作；不新增旋转或肢体展开
promptEn: Organize curved visual flow around existing posture or motion, with trails only from scripted movement; add no rotation or limb extension

promptZh: 暗场聚点构图：利用现有照明中主体与周边的明度差，将亮区偏置于画面一侧作为视觉重心；保留已选光效及暗部中必须可读的人物、道具和动作，不强制将周边压成纯黑。
promptEn: Use existing brightness contrast to make an off-center subject area the visual focus. Preserve the selected lighting and keep required people, props and actions readable in darker regions; do not force the surroundings to pure black.

promptZh: 曲廊回勾构图：利用已有弧线或形体边缘形成回勾的观看路径；不新增曲廊或弯曲结构
promptEn: Use existing curves or shape edges for a returning visual path without adding a curved corridor or reshaping structures

promptZh: 曲面扭转构图：通过广角边缘畸变强化曲面视觉，主体保持可辨；反射仅使用已有介质，不改变实际形体
promptEn: Use wide-angle edge distortion for curved visual emphasis with a legible subject; use only existing reflective media without changing actual geometry

promptZh: 末端守望构图：利用现有纵深线条与重复元素强调画面末端的视觉重量；不移动主体或改变间距
promptEn: Emphasize visual weight at the far end using existing depth lines and repeated elements without moving the subject or changing spacing

promptZh: 框架式构图：以已有开口或结构边缘构成内框，衬托主体；不存在内框条件时使用自然画面边缘，不新增结构
promptEn: Frame the subject through existing openings or structural edges; otherwise use the natural frame edges without adding structures

promptZh: 消失点压缩构图：利用现有透视线与取景压缩形成集中纵深感；保持实际空间、人物位置与通行关系
promptEn: Use existing perspective lines and compressed framing for concentrated depth while retaining actual space, subject positions and passage

promptZh: 烟幕突穿构图：仅在已有烟雾或遮挡中强化轮廓由虚到实的层次；否则以景深表现层次，不新增烟幕或冲出动作
promptEn: Emphasize soft-to-clear contours only within existing haze or occlusion; otherwise use depth of field without adding smoke or a rushing action

promptZh: 爆点后撤构图：以前景主体和已有后景亮点形成纵深对比，沿原动作方向留出空间；不新增爆炸、碎屑、冲击波或逃离
promptEn: Contrast the foreground subject with an existing bright background point, leaving room along scripted movement without adding explosions, debris, shockwaves or escape

promptZh: 环境人像构图:主体占画框三到四成,其余交给他所处的空间;背景中的结构、色调与质感与主体的身份相互印证,而不是随意好看的背景;主体不居中,让环境的一侧承载更多信息;景深适中,前后都保持可读,人与空间互为注解
promptEn: the subject occupying thirty to forty percent of the frame with the rest given to the space they inhabit, the structure, palette and texture behind them corroborating who they are rather than serving as decoration, the figure set off-center so one side carries more environmental information, a moderate depth of field keeping both readable

promptZh: 环形包围构图：利用已有次要元素的弧形分布形成环状视觉联系；不重排元素或填补缺口
promptEn: Use the existing curved distribution of secondary elements for circular visual association without rearranging them or filling gaps

promptZh: 玻璃阻隔构图：仅利用已有透明界面与表面纹理组织前清后虚；不存在界面时采用现有景深，不新增玻璃、水痕或雾气
promptEn: Use existing transparent surfaces and texture for a sharp-near soft-far frame; otherwise use available depth without adding glass, water traces or mist

promptZh: 甩尾切入构图：按正文已有运动方向组织边缘斜切取景，以自然拖影强调速度；不新增入场动作或颗粒
promptEn: Frame existing motion diagonally near an edge, using natural motion trails without adding an entrance or particles

promptZh: 留白构图：利用现有场景中的简洁区域组织留白，主体适度偏向画面一侧，以较低的背景视觉权重突出主体；根据叙事需要保留人物、动作、道具和空间关系，不抹除原场景信息。
promptEn: Build negative space from existing uncluttered areas, placing the subject slightly to one side and reducing incidental background emphasis. Keep the people, actions, props and spatial relationships needed by the narrative without erasing the scene.

promptZh: 碎面追影构图：仅利用已有反射面组织局部影像与主体的层次，保持真实对应；不新增破碎镜面或复制人物
promptEn: Layer partial images only through existing reflective surfaces with physically consistent correspondence, without adding broken mirrors or duplicating people

promptZh: 窄巷夹击构图：利用已有两侧形体压缩横向取景、强化纵深；不新增窄巷、夹击者或封堵去路
promptEn: Compress lateral framing with existing side shapes to emphasize depth without adding an alley, attackers or blocked exits

promptZh: 窄缝窥视构图：通过已有暗部或遮挡形成窄缝视野，保持叙事必要信息；不新增遮挡物
promptEn: Use existing shadow or occlusion for a narrow viewing aperture while retaining essential information, without adding obstacles

promptZh: 纵深回望构图：以纵深线条与正文已有视线方向形成视觉对照，保留人物位置和朝向；不新增回头或行走
promptEn: Contrast existing depth lines with the scripted gaze while retaining positions and orientation, without adding a turn or walking

promptZh: 群体裂口构图：利用已有群体或形体间隙突出主体，保持原有人数、间距与朝向；不新增人群或让路动作
promptEn: Emphasize the subject through existing gaps between people or shapes, retaining their number, spacing and direction without adding a crowd or parting action

promptZh: 群像割裂构图：通过已有结构、明暗或景深分区表现同框层次，保留原有人数与关系；不新增主体或强制隔断
promptEn: Separate visual regions through existing structure, tone or depth while retaining the people and their relationships, without adding subjects or partitions

promptZh: 色块对撞构图：利用现有主要色块的画面占比形成对照，边界清晰；保持物体身份、实际位置和独立滤镜要求
promptEn: Contrast the visual weight of existing major color regions with clear boundaries, retaining object identities, positions and the separate filter

promptZh: 负空间极简构图：利用当前场景中已有的简洁区域形成留白，让主体偏置于画框一角；适度降低非叙事背景的视觉权重，保留必须呈现的人物、道具、动作及空间关系，不抹除剧情所需细节。
promptEn: Use existing uncluttered areas of the scene as negative space, placing the subject toward a corner. Reduce the visual weight of incidental background detail while preserving all required people, props, actions and spatial relationships.

promptZh: 贴地掠行构图:机位压到极低,地面占据画框下半部并向前景急剧放大;地面的纹理在近处清晰、远处收束,形成强烈的透视牵引;主体被安排在中后景较小的位置,天地比例极端失衡,潜行的低姿态由这个高度直接给出
promptEn: the camera dropped extremely low so the ground fills the lower half of the frame and enlarges sharply toward the foreground, its texture crisp up close and converging into the distance for a strong perspective pull, the subject placed small in the mid to far ground, the ratio of ground to sky wildly unbalanced and the crouched posture of stealth stated by the height alone

promptZh: 轮廓贴边构图：在不遮掉本段必要信息的前提下，让主体轮廓接近画框边缘，将更多画面留给正文已描述的关注对象或环境；只有不承担叙事信息的身体区域可出画，不新增观看行为。
promptEn: Bring the subject outline near the frame edge while giving more space to an object or environment already emphasized in the narrative. Crop only body areas that carry no required information; preserve required actions and do not introduce a new act of looking.

promptZh: 边缘悬停构图：将主体置于靠近画框边缘的位置，通过边缘留白比例形成将出未出的张力；仅在不影响动作、口型、道具及交互可读性时允许局部出画，不改变主体动作或制造新的剧情决定。
promptEn: Position the subject near a frame edge and use the remaining margin to create visual tension. Allow partial cropping only where actions, speaking mouths, props and interactions remain readable; do not alter the subject action or invent a narrative decision.

promptZh: 过肩镜头构图：利用已有近处人物肩背衬托原关注对象，按原视线关系取景；不新增对话人物或改变朝向
promptEn: Frame the scripted focal subject past an existing shoulder according to actual eyelines, without adding a conversational partner or changing orientation

promptZh: 运动跟拍构图：若正文已有主体运动，保持该运动的速度和方向，以跟随构图让主体清晰稳定、运动前方留出更多空间；背景可呈现与原运动一致的轻微拖影。静止主体保持静止，不为套用跟拍而新增行进动作。
promptEn: For movement already present in the narrative, preserve its speed and direction while keeping the subject clear and leaving more room ahead. Background motion blur may follow that existing movement. Keep stationary subjects stationary; do not invent travel for the tracking composition.

promptZh: 近远对峙构图：用正文已有近远层次的大小和虚实差形成视觉张力；不新增第二人物或改变实际距离
promptEn: Build tension through scale and focus differences across existing near-far layers without adding a second person or changing actual distance

promptZh: 远端微主体构图：通过宽取景降低主体画面占比，利用现有纵深表现空间尺度；不移动主体或清空环境
promptEn: Reduce the subject's visual share through wide framing and existing depth without moving them or clearing the environment

promptZh: 远近同框异步构图：利用已有近远层次或真实倒影形成一实一虚的呼应，保持姿态和时间一致；不生成同一人物的不同时间状态
promptEn: Create a sharp-soft near-far echo through existing depth or real reflection, with consistent posture and time; do not create different temporal states of a person

promptZh: 逆光剪影群构图：突出已有主体的轮廓与层次差，保留人物身份和必要细节；不新增群体或覆盖独立滤镜
promptEn: Emphasize existing subject contours and depth tiers while retaining identities and essential detail, without adding a group or overriding the filter

promptZh: 逆向视差构图：通过机位与既有层次的视差表现反向视觉流动；不改变物体真实运动方向、空间关系或时间
promptEn: Suggest opposing visual flow through camera parallax across existing layers, without changing actual motion, spatial relations or time

promptZh: 遮半失衡构图：利用现有明暗或既有遮挡边界形成不对称取景，强调主体轮廓与画面两侧的视觉重量差；沿用已选光效，保留本段必需的面部、口型、道具及动作信息，不新增遮挡物或改写人物动机。
promptEn: Use an existing light boundary or occlusion for asymmetrical framing and differing visual weight across the subject outline. Preserve the selected lighting and required facial, speech, prop and action information; add no occluder and infer no new character motive.

promptZh: 遮挡递进构图：利用已有遮挡层次组织由近及远的观看路径；不规定层数、不新增遮挡或移动主体
promptEn: Guide the eye inward through available occlusion layers without requiring a layer count, adding obstructions or moving the subject

promptZh: 错位扑袭构图：利用已有前中景的尺度和虚实差形成透视重叠感；不新增扑击、碰撞或更改实际间距
promptEn: Use scale and focus differences in existing foreground and midground for apparent overlap, without adding a lunge, collision or changing actual spacing

promptZh: 镜面分裂构图：仅利用已有镜面并置主体与真实倒影，保持物理一致；不新增镜面、独立动作或人物副本
promptEn: Place the subject beside a real reflection only in an existing mirror, retaining physical consistency without adding mirrors, independent reflection actions or duplicates

promptZh: 门轴偏置构图：利用已有强垂直线形成不等分取景，主体一侧较窄，朝向一侧留白；不新增站立、转身或门框
promptEn: Use an existing strong vertical for unequal framing with room in the scripted direction, without adding standing, turning or a doorframe

promptZh: 顶光视岛构图：在现有照明允许时，利用主体周围已有的亮区与暗区边界形成光岛式取景；通过画面比例突出主体，同时保留必须呈现的周边信息。沿用已选光效的光源方向、色彩、软硬和明暗层次，不新增唯一顶光或将必要信息压入黑暗。
promptEn: Where the existing lighting permits, frame the subject within an existing pool of light and its surrounding contrast. Emphasize that area through composition while keeping required surroundings readable. Preserve the selected lighting direction, colors, softness and tonal detail; do not impose a sole overhead source or black out narrative information.

promptZh: 顶部压顶构图：增加已有上方结构或暗部的画面占比，减少头顶留白；不新增结构、降低天花板或改变人物姿态
promptEn: Increase the visual weight of existing upper structure or shadow and reduce headroom without adding structures, lowering ceilings or changing posture

promptZh: 高机位俯拍构图:机位高于主体头顶向下取景,俯角三十到六十度,主体被压在画框下部;地面成为占比最大的背景,主体在其中的位置、朝向与彼此距离全部一览无余;体量被俯角削弱,秩序或混乱的关系取代个体成为画面的主要信息
promptEn: the camera above head height looking down at thirty to sixty degrees, the subject pressed into the lower frame, the ground becoming the largest area of background so every position, orientation and distance is laid bare, mass diminished by the angle and the pattern of order or disorder replacing the individual as the primary information
